**Action Plan:**

1. Apply ice therapy to the right knee as frequently as possible to reduce swelling and facilitate healing.
2. Ease up on the running schedule; avoid running if pain increases or necessitates stopping.
3. Continue taking Ibuprofen as needed for knee pain.
4. A prescription for a stronger anti-inflammatory medication will be sent to the pharmacy.
